comment: Scoped npm audit exceptions. Every entry needs an owner decision, a reason and a review date; expired entries fail the gate.

entries.reason: No fixed node-forge release (affected <= 1.4.0, latest 1.4.0). Pulled in only by Expo CLI tooling (@expo/cli -> @expo/code-signing-certificates) for expo-updates code signing; expo-updates is not installed, so the RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 verification path is not in the app bundle.
